$schema_comment: Fixed user-visible refusal copy for Phase 5.3 (message_hint from Phase 4 is internal only).

advisory.body: I cannot provide investment advice or personal recommendations. I can only share factual information from official HSBC scheme pages on Groww.

comparison.body: I cannot compare mutual funds or say which option is better. I can help with factual details from our allowlisted HSBC scheme pages.

mixed_intent.body: Your question mixes factual and advice-seeking wording. Please ask a factual question about one HSBC scheme on Groww.

out_of_scope.body: That question is outside the HSBC mutual fund schemes covered by this assistant.

disambiguate.body: Please name a specific HSBC scheme on Groww so I can look up factual details such as expense ratio or exit load.

performance_info.body: I can point to factual performance data on the official scheme page but cannot predict or project future returns.

fallback.body: I can only answer factual questions from allowlisted official HSBC sources on Groww.
